body:
My friend Jonathan has a simple but meaningful project involving a young man named George. We could all help achieve this goal today, and it would make a big difference in George’s life. It would only take a couple minutes to participate. Here’s how:

 http://www.patheos.com/blogs/jonathanwilsonhartgrove/2012/05/you-can-help-george-win-a-van/

(If it happened to be someone’s birthday and you wanted to give a gift to George in their honor, I know it would be highly appreciated!)
